description: An awards submission producer must lock the binding entry package for the television series The Long Return, including its competition category, representative episode, delivery master, credit line, and screener access.

shared_context.S1: The Long Return is a six-episode television series being entered for this year's international television awards.
shared_context.S2: Mara has authority to submit the final entry package.
shared_context.S3: The draft submission currently lists the Drama Series category, the pilot episode, a 58-minute master, the credit line "A Series by Nia Cole," and a general streaming screener link.
shared_context.S4: The production's final-submission meeting is a routine sign-off at which the rules, broadcaster, and guild representatives each report any confirmed corrections before Mara locks the package.

PF1.text: Jonas checked the awards rulebook with the competition administrator this week and confirmed that a six-episode anthology like The Long Return is eligible only in the "Limited Series" category, not Drama Series; he has not entered the ruling in the submission sheet because the rules team keeps its own eligibility log.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the broadcaster's delivery desk this week that episode 3, "The Crossing," is the required representative episode and that its approved broadcast master is exactly 3,120 seconds long; she has not replaced the draft values because the delivery desk has not yet updated the shared media tracker.

PF3.text: Owen reviewed the signed cast and creator agreements this week and confirmed that the entry must use the exact credit line "Created by Nia Cole" and a password-protected private screener with downloads disabled; he has not changed the draft because guild-and-talent terms are recorded in the agreements register rather than the submission sheet.

acceptance_conditions: The entry must use the Limited Series category.
The representative episode must be The Crossing.
The submitted runtime must be exactly 3,120 seconds.
The credit line must exactly match the creator agreement.
The screener must be private, password-protected, and download-disabled.
The package must record the eligibility, broadcaster-master, credit-line, and screener corrections.

content_checks.C5: decisions['screener_access'] in ['password-protected private link with downloads disabled', 'Password-protected private link with downloads disabled', 'password-protected private screener with downloads disabled', 'Password-protected private screener with downloads disabled']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['eligibility_correction', 'category_correction', 'update_category', 'correction'] or 'category' in c['detail'] or 'eligibility' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: ('PF2' in justification_fact_ids) and (any(c['type'] in ['broadcaster_master_correction', 'episode_and_runtime_correction', 'episode_correction', 'runtime_correction', 'update_episode_and_runtime'] or ('episode' in c['detail'] and 'runtime' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) or (any(c['type'] in ['episode_correction', 'update_episode', 'episode', 'correction'] or 'episode' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] in ['runtime_correction', 'update_runtime', 'runtime', 'correction'] or 'runtime' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)))
content_checks.C8: (any(c['type'] in ['agreement_compliance', 'credit_line_correction', 'update_credit_line'] or 'credit line' in c['detail'] or 'credit' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)) and (any(c['type'] in ['agreement_compliance', 'screener_access_correction', 'screener_correction', 'screener_link_correction', 'update_screener'] or 'screener' in c['detail'] or 'download' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed rule interpretation changes the category from the draft Drama Series entry to exactly Limited Series and requires the eligibility-correction commitment.
The broadcaster's delivery confirmation changes the representative episode from the pilot to episode 3, The Crossing, and changes the runtime from 58 minutes to exactly 3,120 seconds.
The signed agreements change the credit to exactly "Created by Nia Cole," require a password-protected download-disabled screener, and require both agreement-related corrections to be recorded.
